2760-3025-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-3025-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-3025-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

3661-3967-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-3967-5006-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shield Sphere, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

3661-5006-5686-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-5686-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shield Sphere, creating a Blood token
Repeat.

2585-5226-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-5226-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Grim Monolith, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1722-2034-3583-4063.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4063.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

4002-4331-4993-8176.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
4002-4331-4993-8176.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Repeat.

1090-1895-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3378-3821-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3378-3821-4125.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3378-3821-4125.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2061-3617-7487.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-5086-5183-6291-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6291-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

165-206-1069-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-206-1069-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1806-2034-2060-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Ravager such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
2829-6972.description:
Kill Arcbound Ravager.
When Arcbound Ravager dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Ravager from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Ravager dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
2829-6972.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

2034-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2203-2366-4885-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-4885-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-3504.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mercurial Pretender.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-5147-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1850-2573-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-2573-6620.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

3231-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2707-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1} and discarding a land.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1575-4321-5270-6311.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Foods.
You control at least three Foods.
1575-4321-5270-6311.description:
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and three Foods, causing you to add twelve mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and Food tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and Food tokens.
Resolve the Samwise ability, returning Radiant Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Radiant Lotus by paying {6}.
Activate Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing it and an artifact token, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 3.
Activate Peregrin Took by sacrificing three Foods.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers three times, creating three tapped Treasure and three tapped Food tokens.
Resolve the Peregrin Took ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

947-1132-1305-2097.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

4316-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

369-772-2292.notablePrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-772-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1633-2060-2445-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

2034-3496-3902.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have Dread Slaver deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dread Slaver, adding {C}{C}.
When Dread Slaver dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1967-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
1967-2440-3263.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Repeat.

678-1652-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Arts, adding {R}.
Patron of the Arts dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Patron of the Arts by paying {2}{R}.
Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3132-3398-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing and Hellkite Charger.
You have at least eight creature cards in your graveyard.
3132-3398-5231.description:
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least eight 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Zombie Knights, adding seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1475-2646-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1475-2646-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2018-4053-4929.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-4053-4929.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

253-739-3859.description:
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
